At long last, a comprehensive guide on how to design and draw captivating characters—authored by Memenchi, an artist renowned for consistently creating a diverse array of appealing characters—is finally here!

This book provides in-depth explanations on everything from creating charming character designs completely from scratch, to illustration techniques that bring out a character's appeal to its absolute maximum. It also covers fashion design know-how and methods for finishing your work to a high standard of quality.

By reading this book, anyone will be able to create appealing characters and express them in a single illustration.

Additionally, it includes a 16-page gallery featuring Memenchi's stunning past artwork alongside brand-new illustrations drawn exclusively for this book.

16-Page Illustration Gallery

PART 1: Thinking About Character Creation… What makes a character appealing? How to choose a theme, expand ideas, and more.
PART 2: Thinking About Faces & Physicality… Designing facial features that fit the theme, choosing hairstyles, and considering body types.
PART 3: Thinking About Clothing… Understanding garment silhouettes and material impressions; the workflow of costume design.
PART 4: Thinking About Color Schemes… The psychological impression of colors, rules for harmonious color palettes, and color workflows.
PART 5: Thinking About Accessories… Adding props and items to enhance lore, background details, and situations.
PART 6: Thinking About Illustration Themes… Deciding on the mood, impression, and emotions you want to convey through the artwork.
PART 7: Thinking About Character Poses… Designing poses that showcase the character; working with full silhouettes, including clothing.
PART 8: Thinking About Backgrounds… Choosing thematic motifs and arrangements that elevate the main character.
n: [Non-H] Improve by Thinking: How to Create and Draw Characters
